portraits.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: generic anonymous silhouette medallion for a literary character card, The Knight in the Panther's Skin.
Primary request: One clean FACELESS SILHOUETTE placeholder, not a newly imagined detailed portrait. Role is indicated only by a simple outer headwear/hairstyle/clothing outline. No invented individual likeness.
Style: matte deep charcoal-petrol ink silhouette, a single continuous dark filled head/neck/shoulder shape with NO internal facial features. Fine restrained manuscript/gouache finish at the silhouette edges, very subtle paper texture; mostly flat graphic readability. Muted medium-light petrol/slate-blue parchment background INSIDE the circle gives strong contrast with the dark figure. Antique-gold double circular rim with tiny understated interlace, consistent with the existing portrait family.
Composition: one chest-up centered figure in a slight three-quarter view, head and shoulders large and readable. Square canvas preferred1024x1024 or larger. Full complete gold circle entirely visible with equal outer margins. All headwear/crowns/helmet points/figure silhouette must fit completely INSIDE the inner blue field with generous visible blue headroom, never touching or crossing the gold ring. Figure ends naturally at lower circular boundary. Genuine alpha transparency outside the medallion, opaque artwork inside.
Constraints: only ONE person, anonymous. NO eyes, pupils, mouth, nose shading, facial highlights, realistic skin, detailed face, text, labels, initials, numbers, question marks, watermark, halo, modern clothing or props. Do not make a richly painted recognizable person. No hands or weapon/tool props. Keep costume cues broad and generic. The head and face are solid silhouette; facial contours such as a beard may appear only in the outer profile when specified.
Subject: Anonymous older adult hunter silhouette, visible full beard ONLY in outer profile, simple low travel cap and plain cloak shoulders. Older/broader profile, no facial details.
portraits.qa: First generation accepted: anonymous solid dark face, full beard only in outer profile, low travel cap, plain cloak with low-contrast folds. Blue headroom and uninterrupted gold rim; transparent outer alpha retained.
